title: Creative Writing
public_detail: This group will not have a captain but will rely on a volunteer to steer the next gathering. Creative writing and cooperative projects will be explored. Goals for everyone, individually, will determine the goals for the group. This group will meet twice a month on the first and third Wednesdays, 1pm at 41 Sabal Palm Drive.   Bring your ideas to share and your smile. First meeting will be held on September 2 at 1pm. Contact Lisa Bria with any questions at 727-417-6742.
